respond clones its payload at invocation; release resolves that captured value. Changing mode after holding does not retroactively change it. Do not claim a changed-version scenario merely by toggling mode after capture.

notCoveredByTheseFourteenCases: Multiple diff reports with mixed precision or repeated paths and aggregate totals
Real native file I/O or OS cancellation
Real Agent tool result or actual disk write
claimBoundary: This JSON defines independent intended assertions only. No case is marked passed or failed. Later browser results must name actual executed cases and source/harness versions; neither this preparation nor controlled returned diff proves a real tool wrote a file.
